brief:
The Palestinian Prisoners' Defense Center said Israeli occupation forces arrested journalist Muhammad Arab from the Shifa medical complex while he was performing his duties, Shehab Wire reported. Arab has remained imprisoned for more than two years since his arrest, separated from his family and unable to continue his work as a journalist.

The center stated that Arab's fundamental rights have been restricted throughout his detention. His case highlights the situation of media workers held by Israeli authorities while carrying out reporting activities in Gaza.
